reviewed_checks.source_only_forward: CopySourceTagHead.forward accepts source features + source right-padding only. Model creates BEGIN/source/occurrence embeddings, not target prefixes or global output queries. Target/alignment data is used only to compile CE labels or compare alreadydecoded diagnostics.
reviewed_checks.graph_alignment_and_execution: Source graph labels are derived from previously executable canonical programs, then rerendered source gaps/finite punctuation and verified exact target execution. BEGIN0/counts/occurrence indexing and repair pointer masks agree. Identity delta is restricted to exact source==target, retains renderer/executor validation, and does not alter edited gold.
reviewed_checks.traversal_and_caps: Counts0..3, max4 finite inserts per visit, sumcounts+1 transition bound, exhausted-node/cycle and earlyEND rejection. Protected count is forced1 at decode; original strict executor still enforces exact protected bytes/order/once and forbids fabricated lexical/numeric joins.
reviewed_checks.default_identity: Zero output-head weights + keep/count1/formcopy/repairoff/noinsert biases provide identity for valid source controls; pointer scores are inactive with repairOFF. Actual model execution belongs to a separate unit gate.
reviewed_checks.loss_masks: Typed long target tensors, right-padding masks and active-visit/repair/insertion branch masks. CE selects supervised rows before crossentropy. Fully ignored components use empty-slice differentiable zero, avoiding0*infinity/NaN from ignored pointer entries.
reviewed_checks.fixed_denominators: Fixed64 rows and48/16 split retained in label inventory, evaluation and metrics; feature-unavailable/deadline cases remain failures/unattempted entries. Unsupported labels skipCE only and still receive source-only inference. Actual usedCE IDs update after completed optimizer.step.
reviewed_checks.owned_workers: Explicit operation/source/input/settings/output grant; exact interpreter spelling; source/cache native-release checks before Torch; independent process session/group; finite supervisor timeout +TERM/KILL/reap; create-only output and explicit release status. No native model is called by head unit/train workers.
reviewed_checks.historical_scope: New modules are work-only; oldcore/dependency pins are unchanged and held01 source/unit history remains distinct. Structural executability/static coverage and exact-canonical diagnostics do not establish semantic quality or app SLA.
